name: superchatdev
description: Purpose-built MCP development runtime for ChatGPT Web with native file handoff and durable jobs

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs web/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; python3 -c "import pathlib; [compile(p.read_text(),str(p),'exec') for d in ['src','scripts','deploy'] for p in pathlib.Path(d).glob('*.py')]"
